tasks.title: right-panel parity surface: contract WO settings panel sections against OO deep census
tasks.description: The OO reference for the right settings panel is captured (wo-test-harness/census/census/census-oo-deep.json key 'rightPanel': 'toggles' = 17 rail buttons, 'openedSections' = section/field titles like Line spacing / Paragraph spacing / Indents / Rows & columns size / Borders style / Size / Opacity / Rotation / Wrapping Style / Fill). WO's right panel is #right-panel (aside, hidden by default) with a rail nav #right-rail button[data-panel] for 5 sections: paragraph, table, image, chart, mailmerge; sections live in #right-panel-body .rp-section[data-section=...] each with a .rp-title and fields. It opens via data-cmd=toggleRightPanel (View tab, btn-right-panel-toggle) or openRightPanelSection(name) (editor.js ~6732-6790). Write tests/parity/surfaces/right-panel.cjs mirroring tests/parity/surfaces/tab-census.cjs conventions (require ../_boot.cjs, ensureServer/launchBrowser/openEditor with boot.BASE, results json written to tests/parity/right-panel-results.json, explicit process.exit): (1) open the panel, assert #right-panel visible (not [hidden]) and toggle btn aria-pressed=true; (2) for each of the 5 rail sections click the rail button and assert its .rp-section becomes the visible one (other sections hidden) and collect the count of visible interactive fields (input, select, button, label+input pairs) inside the active section; (3) floors in tests/parity/right-panel-floors.json: paragraph >= 8 (line-spacing select, indents left/right/special, spacing before/after, advanced link), table >= 4 (rows, cols, border controls), image >= 4 (width, height, rotation, wrapping), chart >= 1, mailmerge >= 1 — ADJUST floors to measured values minus 2 after first run (report mode), but never below 1; (4) OO coverage check: load census-oo-deep.json (path ../../wo-test-harness/census/census/census-oo-deep.json relative to server root — resolve via process.env.WO_OO_CENSUS if set, default the absolute path /home/weiss/git/World-Office/wo-test-harness/census/census/census-oo-deep.json) and assert that each OO openedSections group anchor (Line spacing, Paragraph spacing, Indents, Rows, Columns, Borders, Size, Rotation, Wrapping) has a WO counterpart: a .rp-title or field label whose text matches case-insensitively (substring) across the 5 WO sections. Report matched/missing OO anchors; FAIL if any of the mandatory anchors (Line spacing, Indents, Rows, Columns, Size, Rotation, Wrapping) is missing. Note: table/image sections may need selection context (a table/image in the doc) — if fields show only with selection, plant the fixture like tab-census's contextual setups (reuse the contract runner's table/image fixtures — grep contract-runner.cjs for table-selection / image-selection pres flows). chart + mailmerge floors of >= 1 may be satisfied by the rail button + section title alone if fields need deeper context. Do NOT touch editor source, contract-runner vocabulary, or the other surfaces. Verify: WO_PORT=19850 /usr/bin/node tests/parity/surfaces/right-panel.cjs exits 0 and prints per-section floors ok.
tasks.accept: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && WO_PORT=$((19000 + RANDOM % 800)) /usr/bin/node tests/parity/surfaces/right-panel.cjs && WO_PORT=$((19000 + RANDOM % 800)) bash tests/parity/af-gate.sh 451
